claim_under_test.record: SETTLED - CONTRADICTED at the declared margin 0.10: Phase-384 v2 governing basic interval [0.058939204306206666, 0.0777941604081594], point V 0.11539837515155221, n = 1,670 Holdat inscriptions; family sibling STUDY-SPEC-024/F3-ICIT stands SUPPORTED at the same margin (governing interval [0.18229651053139323, 0.21036863506165235], point V 0.21900847512892316, n = 5,410)

design.hypothesis: on the population the two layers share (same sites, same object types), the Holdat effect and the ICIT effect move toward each other - the layer disagreement is substantially a composition difference
design.falsifier: on the shared population the two layers' governing intervals still exclude each other (COMPOSITION DOES NOT) - stated under the corrected hand-off of spec section 2.3: the outcome stands alongside Spec 034's finished attribution (D-20 complete, Phase-398, ATTRIBUTED TO COMPOSITION on 169 matched objects, all Mohenjo-daro seals, median distance 0.025694, residual 0.040340), both statements stand, and no successor study is designed, registered, or implied
design.arm1_margin_curve: the Phase-384 v2 estimator unchanged (populations built by the Phase-137 module's own loaders and frozen population rule; inscription-level bootstrap within site, site sizes fixed, B = 9,999, seed 20261012, the basic bootstrap interval governing), reported on the fixed grid 0.05 / 0.075 / 0.10 / 0.125 / 0.15 with each cell worded by the frozen family rule (CONTRADICTED AT m if the governing interval's upper bound is below m; SUPPORTED AT m if its lower bound is above m; STRADDLES m otherwise), labelled sensitivity in every output; the recorded verdict at 0.10 stands and no cell replaces it

shared_population.sites: the sites present in both layers' Phase-137 analysis populations - on the record six sites (Chanhu-daro, Dholavira, Harappa, Kalibangan, Lothal, Mohenjo-daro), re-derived from the pinned layers at gate 0.4 rather than trusted from the text
shared_population.type_ruling: DD-060-12 (OPEN-060-4 resolved): DD-060-3 is CONFIRMED - the Phase-137 record states verbatim that the Holdat layer carries no object-type field and its inscriptions are seal texts, so the type mix is a constant; the type present in both layers is SEAL, the Holdat side enters whole, and the ICIT side is restricted to its recorded SEAL type class (the Phase-137 loader's type class, from the recorded type field); no inscription is re-typed and no other type class enters
shared_population.measurement: the site-effect size is computed in each layer separately with identical code (the Phase-384 v2 estimator), each layer in its own sign numbering; the two layers' signs are never pooled, mapped, or harmonised, and the comparison is of the two governing intervals only

design.period_ruling: DD-060-13 (OPEN-060-4 resolved): DD-060-4 is CONFIRMED - neither Phase-137 loader reads a period field (Holdat fields used: letters, position, seal_id, site; ICIT fields used: text, site, type; the Phase-137 record's confounder statement records period as not available in these layers), so where a layer carries no period field the outcome states PERIOD MIX NOT DESCRIBED FOR THIS LAYER - FIELD NOT CARRIED, period is never treated as controlled, and no period assignment is imported from any other source, including any Spec 041-style assignment
design.calibration_ruling: DD-060-14 (OPEN-060-2 resolved): gate 0.3 - exact reproduction of both recorded governing intervals by the unchanged estimator on the two full populations - is this spec's estimator check; no fresh synthetic calibration is required beyond it, and none may be introduced at execution as a gate
design.venue_ruling: DD-060-15 (OPEN-060-3 resolved): the execution venue is the owner's machines at the Phase-137 loaders' default paths as recorded in the Phase-137 results (the Holdat copy under the program checkout's corpora/downloads/external_repos/holdatllc_indus/, the ICIT copy under the research-notes sweep downloads/horus84-computational-linguistics/data/); at the freeze both copies at those paths hash exactly to the section 3 pins, and gate 0.1 asserts the execution venue's copies against the same pins; no other copy is authoritative
design.too_thin_ruling: DD-060-11 (OPEN-060-4 resolved): DD-060-2 is CONFIRMED - the gate-0.4 floors (fewer than 5 shared sites or fewer than 500 inscriptions in either layer) close arm 2 only, with the counts stated; arm 1 is independent of the shared census and still reports
design.step0_gates: fail-closed, in order, before any arm quantity (spec section 4): gate 0.1 input integrity - every section 3 input hashes to its stated value, the two held layer files to the values recorded in the Phase-137 results, a mismatch stops the run as INVALID; gate 0.2 population reproduction, both layers - the Phase-137 loaders and frozen population rule reproduce each recorded profile table exactly (Holdat 1,670 inscriptions, 9 x 98, chi2 745.953, V 0.1154; ICIT 5,410 inscriptions, 7 x 187, chi2 4966.362, V 0.2190), a mismatch stops the run as INVALID; gate 0.3 estimator regression - the Phase-384 v2 estimator run unchanged on the two full-layer populations reproduces the recorded governing intervals exactly, a mismatch stops the run as INVALID; gate 0.4 shared-population census - a thin census closes arm 2 as TOO THIN only; nothing is repaired at run time
design.freeze_does_not: this freeze does not itself compute anything: no margin-curve cell beyond the recorded 0.10 adjudication, no shared-population quantity, and not the gate-0.4 census, which remains an execution act; it moves no verdict (F2 stands CONTRADICTED at 0.10 and F3 stands SUPPORTED at 0.10 exactly as recorded), re-runs no part of Spec 034, and imports no period assignment
